title: neomarica paradoxa
intro: Neomarica paradoxa, commonly known as the "Maypuri" or "Ring of Fire" plant, is a flowering plant species in the family Iridaceae. It is known for its bright orange and red flowers, which resemble a ring of fire when in bloom. Neomarica paradoxa has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and iridoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
